# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## System and Application Header
- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "campaign_slides.pptx - LibreOffice Impress"
- **System Information Bar**: Shows "Oct 22 19:30" with a notification bell icon
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **Desktop Environment**: "Activities" label on the top-left corner

## Desktop Environment and Application Dock
- **Left Dock Panel**: Contains application icons including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress (currently active)
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help Icon
  - Trash Icon
- **Bottom Dock Panel**: Contains a grid icon for application launcher

## Menu Bar
- **Main Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbars
- **Main Toolbar**: Contains icons for:
  - File operations (New, Open, Save, Print)
  - Edit operations (Cut, Copy, Paste)
  - Slide operations (New Slide, Duplicate Slide, Delete Slide)
  - Drawing tools (Shapes, Lines, Arrows, Text Box, Callouts, Stars, Rectangles)
  - Formatting tools (Text alignment, Bullet points, Numbering, Font styles, Color fills)
  - Slide show controls (Start Slide Show, Presenter View)
  - Object manipulation tools (Selection, Grouping, Align, Distribute)
  - Special tools (Equation editor, Character formatting, Linking, Drawing tools, Object properties)

## Slide Navigation Panel
- **Location**: Left side of the interface
- **Slide Thumbnails**: Shows thumbnails for slides 1 to 4
  - Slide 1: Contains text "Eradicating Heritable Disorders Through Prenatal Identification" and a large white arrow pointing up-right
  - Slide 2: Contains a large white arrow pointing up-right
  - Slide 3: Contains a large white arrow pointing up-right
  - Slide 4: Contains a large white arrow pointing up-right (currently selected)
- **Slide Indicator**: "Slide 4 of 4" at the bottom of the panel

## Main Slide Editing Area
- **Current Slide**: Slide 4, using the "BLANK_4" layout
- **Slide Content**: A large yellow background with a large white arrow pointing up-right
- **Slide Properties**: The slide is formatted as "On-screen w (16:9)" with "Landscape" orientation and "None" background

## Properties Panel
- **Location**: Right side of the interface
- **Panel Title**: "Properties"
- **Slide Properties Section**:
  - Format: "On-screen w (16:9)"
  - Orientation: "Landscape"
  - Background: "None"
  - Master Slide: "BLANK_4"
  - Master Background: Checked
  - Master Objects: Checked
  - Master View: Button available
- **Layouts Section**: Collapsed, indicated by a right-pointing arrow

## LibreOffice Donation Banner
- **Location**: Top of the main editing area, below the toolbar
- **Banner Content**:
  - First message: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with a "Get involved" button
  - Second message: "Your donations support our worldwide community." with a "Donate" button
- **Banner Design**: Light blue background with information icons

## Status Bar
- **Location**: Bottom of the interface
- **Information Displayed**:
  - Current slide: "Slide 4 of 4"
  - Layout name: "BLANK_4"
  - Slide dimensions: "27.13 / 4.58"
  - Object position: "0.00 x 0.00"
  - Zoom level: "123%"
  - Language: "English (en)"
- **Zoom Controls**: Slider with minus and plus buttons for adjusting zoom level

## Additional UI Elements
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in the top-right corner
- **System Tray**: Located in the top-right corner, showing system icons
- **Application Icons**: Located in the top-left corner, showing the LibreOffice logo and other application icons

- **Properties Panel**: Located in the right panel, showing properties of the selected slide
